brief:
Israel conducted attacks across Gaza that killed two people and struck a warehouse storing hospital supplies, according to Gaza's Health Ministry. The ministry reported rising casualties as Israeli operations intensified, with rescue efforts underway at sites where victims lay trapped beneath rubble from the strikes.

The damage to the warehouse threatened to compound existing supply shortages affecting Gaza's already strained healthcare infrastructure. Hospital facilities across the territory have faced mounting pressure to treat growing numbers of casualties amid the escalating military operations.
dek: Gaza’s Health Ministry reports rising casualties amid escalated Israeli attacks, with victims trapped under rubble.
title: Israeli strikes in Gaza kill two, damage hospital supply warehouse
